# snipeit_status_label (Data Source)

Looks up a single status label by `id` or exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_status_label" "ready" {
  name = "Ready to Deploy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the status label. Set it to look up by id.
- `name` (String) Name of the status label. Set it to look up by exact name.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Hex chart color of the label.
- `default_label` (Boolean) Whether this label is pinned to the top of the status dropdown.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `show_in_nav` (Boolean) Whether assets with this label appear in the side navigation.
- `type` (String) Meta type of the label (`deployable`, `pending`, `undeployable`, `archived`).
